@cleanupRouteNotFound.description: Title and body of the fallback screen shown when the app navigates to a page that does not exist.

@cleanupNotificationSubtitle.description: iOS subtitle line under the title of a push notification sent from the server: 'New notification'.

@cleanupNotificationActionView.description: Button on a push notification (Android): open/view it. One short word.

@cleanupNotificationActionDismiss.description: Button on a push notification (Android): dismiss it. One short word.

cleanupDownloadActionFailed: تعذّر إتمام عملية التنزيل. حاول مرة أخرى.

@cleanupDownloadActionFailed.description: Error snackbar on the Downloads screen when starting/pausing/resuming/cancelling/opening a download fails.

@cleanupDownloadStatusQueued.description: Download status under a file name: waiting in the queue to start.

@cleanupDownloadStatusCanceled.description: Download status under a file name: the download was cancelled.

@cleanupDownloadStatusUnknown.description: Download status under a file name when the state is unknown.

@cleanupRadioMediaArtist.description: Second line on the lock screen / media notification while a Quran radio station is playing: 'Holy Quran Radio'.

@cleanupDhikrMeaningSubhanAllah.description: Short meaning shown in small text under the built-in dhikr «سبحان الله» in the Tasbih (the dhikr itself stays Arabic). Arabic source is a short explanation; other languages give the translation of the phrase, e.g. 'Glory be to Allah'.

@cleanupDhikrMeaningAlhamdulillah.description: Short meaning under the built-in dhikr «الحمد لله» in the Tasbih. Other languages: translation of the phrase, e.g. 'All praise is due to Allah'.

@cleanupDhikrMeaningLaIlaha.description: Short meaning under the built-in dhikr «لا إله إلا الله» in the Tasbih. Other languages: translation, e.g. 'There is no god but Allah'.

@cleanupDhikrMeaningAllahuAkbar.description: Short meaning under the built-in dhikr «الله أكبر» in the Tasbih. Other languages: translation, e.g. 'Allah is the Greatest'.

cleanupDhikrMeaningLaHawla: لا تحوّل ولا قدرة إلا بعون الله

@cleanupDhikrMeaningLaHawla.description: Short meaning under the built-in dhikr «لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله» in the Tasbih. Other languages: translation, e.g. 'There is no might nor power except with Allah'.

@cleanupDhikrMeaningAstaghfirullah.description: Short meaning under the built-in dhikr «أستغفر الله» in the Tasbih. Other languages: translation, e.g. 'I seek forgiveness from Allah'.

@cleanupDhikrMeaningSubhanAllahWaBihamdi.description: Short meaning under the built-in dhikr «سبحان الله وبحمده سبحان الله العظيم» in the Tasbih. Other languages: translation, e.g. 'Glory be to Allah and praise Him, glory be to Allah the Magnificent'.
